requirement.description: The SubprocessCLITransport.receive_messages() method is returning a coroutine instead of an async iterator, causing 'TypeError: 'async for' requires an object with __aiter__ method, got coroutine' errors in multiple tests.
requirement.contract: The receive_messages() method must return an async iterator (AsyncIterator[dict[str, Any]]) that can be used with 'async for' loops. The method should properly yield parsed message data asynchronously.

requirement.description: The SubprocessCLITransport.disconnect() method is not properly closing the stdin stream in all code paths, leading to 'Expected 'close' to have been called once' assertion errors in context manager tests.
requirement.contract: The disconnect() method must ensure that stdin stream is properly closed and cleaned up in all execution paths to prevent resource leaks and ensure proper cleanup.

requirement.description: The SubprocessCLITransport._stream_to_stdin() method has issues with closing stdin streams properly, causing problems when used in query() function with close_stdin_after_prompt=True.
requirement.contract: The _stream_to_stdin() method should properly manage the stdin stream lifecycle, especially when close_stdin_after_prompt is True, ensuring streams are closed appropriately after sending prompts.

requirement.description: The ClaudeSDKClient.receive_messages() method has an incorrect implementation that doesn't properly handle the async iterator from transport.
requirement.contract: The receive_messages() method should correctly delegate to transport.receive_messages() and properly yield parsed messages from the async iterator.

requirement.description: The InternalClient.process_query() method has issues with transport cleanup and stream handling when processing queries with close_stdin_after_prompt=True.
requirement.contract: The process_query() method should properly manage the transport lifecycle and ensure cleanup happens correctly regardless of execution path.
